uvod.tekst: We invite you to try our excellent pizzas, prepared with love and the skilled hand of experienced pizzaiolo Marko. In addition to crispy pizzas, we also offer other delicious dishes made especially for you. We also provide group lunches for 15 or more people upon prior reservation at 031/307-279.

ambient.naslov: A cozy atmosphere for all generations
ambient.tekst: Our interior is designed 'from the floor' – of a wooden rustic building. The heart of the space is the wood-fired oven, which brings warmth and a relaxed atmosphere.

okolica.tekst: Our inn is located on a picturesque hill with a stunning view of the Krka River valley. Just a few steps away rises Bovljek Hill, a popular spot for short hikes and relaxation in nature. After a refreshing hike or trip, you can recharge here with Neapolitan pizzas, refreshing drinks, and enjoy the fresh air and pleasant ambience.
okolica.list1: Unforgettable view of the Krka River valley
okolica.list2: Great starting point for short hikes
okolica.list3: Pleasant environment for relaxation and socializing

gostilna.opis_1: Some time ago, our dream came true. In Suha Krajina, in the village of Kuželjevec, we opened Inn Under the Floor. We invite you to try our delicious pizzas made with love and other treats we create for you.
gostilna.opis_2: Every visit and every compliment means a lot to us – it drives us forward and gives us even more motivation to work. Thank you for believing in our efforts!

lokacija.opis_1: On the terrace, you'll enjoy a beautiful view of the surrounding hills, green forests in spring, autumn colors, and a winter wonderland – in all seasons. You'll feel peace, relax, and hear birds chirping. You can take a walk up nearby Bovljek Hill. Experience it with us – you're warmly invited!
lokacija.opis_2: Just 20 minutes' walk from the inn rises Bovljek Hill, a popular destination for short hikes. The trail to the top is easy and suitable for all ages. In the near future, a lookout tower will be built at the top, offering visitors a view of the entire Suha Krajina region and beyond. The tower will become a new attraction for nature lovers, photographers, and anyone seeking peace in the hills.
